propositions: Collapse the vestigial `## Success Criteria` heading into the single blocking `## Acceptance Criteria` vocabulary across detectors, reviewer prompts, routing index, docs, eval specs, tests, and store tickets.
Criteria under `## Success Criteria` are not counted by `_count_ac_items`, cannot carry `[operator-attested]`, and are not individually checkable, so collapsing tightens the gate.
Migration is sequenced expand-contract so no ticket becomes un-reviewable while its heading is in transit.
Three live files legitimately retain success-criteria wording (T2 trial-metrics phrase and two dod_uncertifiable sites plus verify_models.py) and must be excluded as false positives.
Store migration moves every SC-heading ticket's criteria to `- [ ]` AC checklist items, leaving zero SC headings and untouched backticked prose mentions.
Several acceptance criteria were mutually unsatisfiable as written and required mid-implementation amendment, prompting a filed process bug about plan review certifying contradictory criteria.
